meta.note: Dining options are NOT included in holiday package budgets. They are shown as nearby suggestions only. Price bands: $ = quick/affordable ($8-18pp), $$ = casual family dining ($18-35pp), $$$ = premium ($35-60+pp). Opening hours may vary — check before visiting.

venues.name: King Ludwigs German Restaurant & Bier Bar
venues.notes: Authentic Bavarian restaurant with stunning Glass House Mountain views. Schnitzels, pork knuckle, sausages, plus a kids' menu. Lively atmosphere with imported German beers.

venues.name: The Edge Restaurant Montville
venues.notes: Perched on the escarpment edge with panoramic hinterland views. Breakfast and lunch with a deck that overlooks the valley. A Montville institution for scenic dining.

venues.name: Poets Cafe Montville
venues.notes: Iconic Montville cafe on the main street — all-day breakfast, light lunches, great coffee, and a balcony with valley views. Family-friendly with a relaxed mountain atmosphere.

venues.name: The Tamarind Restaurant at Spicers Tamarind Retreat
venues.notes: Award-winning Thai fine dining in a rainforest pavilion near Maleny. Seasonal menu, exceptional flavours, and a tranquil setting. Special occasion dinner — early sittings work for families.

venues.name: The Long Apron at Spicers Clovelly Estate
venues.notes: Hatted fine dining in a French-provincial estate near Montville. Degustation and a la carte menus, exceptional service, and an elegant setting. Special occasion only.

venues.name: Secrets on the Lake
venues.notes: Iconic hinterland destination restaurant nestled in rainforest near Montville — Dining on the Deck offers casual lunch with stunning lake and forest views. Family-friendly atmosphere.

venues.name: Maleny Hotel Bistro
venues.notes: Classic pub bistro in the historic Maleny Hotel — steak, parmy, fish & chips, kids' meals ~$12. Beer garden, live music, and a genuine local vibe in the heart of Maleny.

venues.name: Brouhaha Brewery
venues.notes: Craft brewery in Maleny with a family-friendly beer garden — excellent burgers, share plates, and house-brewed beers. Relaxed atmosphere, outdoor seating, and live music some weekends.

venues.name: Maleny Food Co
venues.notes: Local favourite cafe and deli on Maleny's main street — great coffee, fresh sandwiches, pastries, and gourmet picnic supplies. Perfect for takeaway before a national park walk.

venues.name: Kondalilla Restaurant
venues.notes: Rainforest restaurant near Kondalilla Falls — Modern Australian cuisine with a focus on local produce. Beautiful setting surrounded by trees. Great for a post-walk lunch.

venues.name: The Barn on Flaxton
venues.notes: Rustic-chic restaurant in a converted barn near Montville — share plates, wood-fired dishes, and a relaxed hinterland atmosphere. Family-friendly with a charming country setting.

venues.name: Maleny Cheese Factory Cafe
venues.notes: Artisan cheese cafe in Maleny — cheese platters, toasted sandwiches, light lunches, and tastings. Watch cheese being made while you eat. A unique foodie stop for families.
